My dear [Miss Ingelow](../persons.html#741)
This is [Mr Stone](../persons.html#1371)’s answer about the knight of Intercession.

It seems to be one of the legends that evades all search.

How would it be to send a question to Notes and Queries?
I have been wishing to tell you that the last sermon that I heard [Mr Keble](../persons.html#798) preach, a year and half ago, - one on the anniversary of his Church Consecration, he brought in a sentence about the Church bells sounding on the ear of travellers in the desert, and he told me afterwards that it came out of ‘the one story by two Authors’.[^1]

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: One story by two authors; or, A tale without a moral by Jean Ingelow and Frances Mary Levett was serialised in MP 1860-61 and published \'with additions\' in 1862.
